2348.hook: Holmes sends Watson on a fashionable trip after a wealthy noblewoman who has stopped writing home.

2349.hook: Holmes, resting in a Cornish cottage, sends a strange telegram, and a sinister affair on the moors soon draws them in.

2350.hook: Seven late Holmes cases: a face at a lonely window, stolen submarine plans, a Cornish horror, and one last job before the war.

2351.hook: A frail boy and a ragged orphan meet in the rain, and a lifelong friendship begins.

2352.hook: A dreaming sailor wakes ashore in a utopian republic run on radical new ideals of justice.

2353.hook: Six sharp companions argue love, art and women over endless cups of tea.

2354.hook: Huxley takes apart the claim that the human brain stands apart from every other primate's.

2355.hook: Darwin's last book finds world-shaping power, and a glimmer of mind, in the humble earthworm.

2356.hook: A threadbare hack journalist's quiet evening is upended by a ragged, gender-mysterious waif named Tommy.

2358.hook: A broke young doctor ships out as a common sailor, and wakes to axe murder aboard a yacht.

2359.hook: A poet-thief flees a killing through snowbound Paris and must talk his way through one long night.

2360.hook: A bored clerk accepts a dreary yachting invitation and finds his friend is hiding something out among the sandbanks.

2361.hook: A college president makes the case that a woman's education is worth far more than insurance against misfortune.

2362.hook: The founding, fire, and flowering of a pioneering women's college told by one of its own.

2363.hook: Two friends, two masked strangers, and three days in Florence to untangle an impossible courtship.

2365.hook: A great heiress is married for politics while her heart stays with another man.

2366.hook: A painter agrees to portray a beautiful lady, and discovers what her companion's plain face really is.

2369.hook: A restless Nebraska farm boy hungers for a larger life the war will offer.

2370.hook: A mute, radiant street child of a grey Scottish city drifts toward the hills and an unlooked-for inheritance.

2371.hook: A young detective gets his big case: a light burning in a Washington house nobody will enter.

2372.hook: Two men who have sworn off women share a lonely lighthouse, and the shore refuses to cooperate.

2373.hook: A famous lecture reframing law as prediction, seen through the cold eyes of the bad man.

2374.hook: A young lord defies his father to marry the lodge keeper's beautiful daughter.

2375.hook: A boastful provincial hero sets off to hunt lions in far-off Algeria.

2376.hook: Born on a Virginia plantation without so much as a surname of his own, he walked five hundred miles to reach a schoolhouse door.

2377.hook: Nine Klondike tales of men, dogs and hunger against the vast indifferent quiet of the frozen North.

2378.hook: The finest short poems of the Greek world, on love, death, and fleeting beauty.

2379.hook: A poet's fatal devotion to Mary Stuart plays out in the candlelit rooms of Holyrood.

2381.hook: Kipling's tales range from an English farm to the skies of the future.

2382.hook: A frontier delegate argues for a new territory, mapping rivers, silver and danger across the Gadsden Purchase.

2385.hook: A woman drags her trunk downstairs, announces she will write a travel book, and sets off.

2386.hook: A forty-year friend paints Theodore Roosevelt up close, from sickly boy to the storm center of a nation.

2388.hook: On the eve of battle, a troubled prince receives divine counsel on duty, action, and the soul.

2389.hook: A courtier wagers his fortune that he can win a lady he has never met.

2390.hook: The romantic, dangerous story of the pioneers who pushed west into Kentucky and Tennessee.

2391.hook: An unwanted collie's puppy grows into the war dog who guides blinded men through no man's land.
2391.era: America and First World War France

2392.hook: A collie puppy arrives to guard a lakeside home and quietly wins everyone instead.

2393.hook: A worn-out hill farmer scraping by alone finds his life changed by one remarkable dog.

2394.hook: A guide who spent a decade on its trails tells you exactly how to meet the Grand Canyon.

2395.hook: A stolen prince raised by a centaur sails with the greatest heroes of Greece after a golden fleece.

2396.hook: A sweeping account of the Church caught between medieval order and the shocks of the modern age.

2401.hook: A cavalry officer's vivid memoirs of duels, campaigns, and hair-raising escapes under Napoleon.

2412.hook: Aristotle's foundational treatise sorting how things are named and what it means for something simply to be.

2417.hook: A meek old music-hall performer, a murder, and a spy ring hidden in wartime London.

2424.hook: A galley slave prays for vengeance, breaks his chain, and sails toward a cursed treasure.

2432.hook: A cathedral town goes quietly to war over who will hold the bishop's chair.

2433.hook: A young tutor walks away from everything he knows and into a castle full of secrets.

2434.hook: A becalmed ship finds an unknown land, where a courteous and devout people guard a hidden house of learning.

2436.hook: A grieving daughter realises her father intends to remarry, and sets out to stop it.

2437.hook: A father plans a modest country house and discovers his children have plans of their own.

2438.hook: An American girl abroad charms her bewildered Italian servants while a family mystery simmers beneath the surface.

2439.hook: Macaulay charts how a king at the summit of power threw everything away in three short years.

2446.hook: A doctor discovers the town's celebrated baths are poisoned, and learns what it costs to tell the truth.

2450.hook: A boy leaves the country house where his mother died and grows raw and watchful in Moscow.

2451.hook: In a freezing Paris garret, two beautiful young lodgers drift into a blackmailer's web.

2452.hook: In a gossipy Cape Cod town, a windmill-maker's quiet kindness upends everyone's assumptions.

2454.hook: A professor of crime turns test tubes and blood science on murders the police cannot crack.

2456.hook: Herodotus recounts the sprawling wars, customs, and wonders of the ancient world.

2460.hook: In moonlit Florence a stranger promises the greatest painting of the age, forever unfinished.

2461.hook: A gardener's son schemes his way toward the proudest beauty in Lyons.

2463.hook: A gentleman stargazer in Berkeley Square discovers he can foretell the future, to his social ruin.

2466.hook: Young Russian idealists throw themselves into a secret cause, testing their hopes against a stubborn country.

2471.hook: A barque bound for San Francisco turns aside, and her passengers find themselves captives on a forgotten coast.

2472.hook: A contented Breton baron's perfect world is about to be undone by revolution and small deceptions.

2473.hook: A whole Cape Cod town wonders the same thing at a funeral: what becomes of little Mary-'Gusta?

2475.hook: Two circus performer friends get thrilling news about their summer on the road.

2476.hook: Two young performers tour the South with the circus, and rivals follow the show closely.

2477.hook: The circus boys take the big show down the Mississippi, with a grudge riding along.

2478.hook: A gale hammers the big top, and two circus boys are sent ahead of the show.

2480.hook: A St. Petersburg student is drawn into revolutionary intrigue and its long moral aftermath.

2483.hook: A girl rises early to fix her father's breakfast and finds her quiet mid-western town anything but ordinary.

2491.hook: A dreaming young woman on the shore stands at the threshold between innocence and a woman's fate.

2492.hook: A penniless Greek singer finally gets his chance at a grand London party, on the worst possible day.

2495.hook: An orphan of the plains, adopted into a Spanish rancho, grows restless with the life given her.

2496.hook: Walks, neighbours, and hedgerow flowers in a small English village, drawn with unhurried affection.

2498.hook: A fireside talk on one chapter of Corinthians that argues love outranks everything else.
